title: edge_projection_docs streaming at >100k docs
wanted_capability: Refactor `edge_projection_docs` from `AllQuery` + `TopDocs::with_limit` to streaming/segment iteration so it scales past 100k docs without OOM.
notes: Codex added `tracing::warn!` at 100k; refactor to streaming/segment iteration before that fires in production.
resolution_note: Replaced AllQuery + TopDocs::with_limit with for_each_edge_projection_doc — streaming segment doc-store iteration (StoreReader::iter with alive-bitset, sequential block decompression, one doc live at a time). edge_index now projects transcript IN_SESSION edges inline and buffers only project_file chunks for the chunk[0] file-proxy grouping; mid-stream errors drop the partial buffer rather than emitting wrong file proxies. Commit 9c630f6 on worktree-edge-projection-streaming (based on beta/blackbox-v2). Covered by 3 new tests (multi-segment + deleted-doc skip, callback error propagation, end-to-end IN_SESSION/IN_FILE projection semantics).
